push.body:
A 7.9 against FC TBD, BellyTb1. Good bones. Now let's hang some pictures on 'em.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against FC TBD. Every team needs someone who smells goals. You've got the nose.
+ You and PhogsToffees were like salt and pepper tonight. Better together.
+ Pass accuracy 86%, up from your usual 74%. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ 1 key pass bought you +0.1. Sprinkles on the sundae.
+ 2 goals conceded: +0.1. That's how good ratings get built.

THE BAD
- Shots 1, down from your usual 4. Let's sharpen this: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.
- Tackles won 0, down from your usual 1. Golden rule: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
- Pass accuracy: 86%. The good neighborhood starts at 88%+.
- Key passes: 1. Good. Great starts at 2+.

Tonight's homework: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

Effort today, results tomorrow. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 2-2 vs FC TBD | You: 7.8
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.8 against FC TBD. A good honest shift, like a well-made chair.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against FC TBD, your 3rd straight match scoring. The net said thank you, and so do I.
+ 1 assist (down from your usual 2). Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ You and BellyTb1 turned simple passes into goals.
+ 3rd straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's growth you can count.
+ 23 completed passes: +0.2. Do that again.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Easy money: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. Water the plant.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Habit to build: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
- 1 tackle won dropped 0.1. Simple fix.
- Pass accuracy: 74%. Good foundation, 88%+ ceiling.

Repetition station: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

PhogsToffees, from me to you: The ball doesn't know your rating. Neither should your attitude.

Never mind the noise; mind the next rep. - Coach Lasso
